scenes.title: Open-air market, Cairo Citadel (1907)

source.description: Open-air market beneath the Cairo Citadel, with a crowd gathered in the foreground and the Citadel's mosque and minarets in the background.

scenes.anomaly: Time traveler: young man in robes with modern athletic sneakers
scenes.explanation: Modern athletic sneakers (with visible swoosh-style branding and thick soles) only became common in the 1960s, so they cannot appear in a 1907 photograph.
scenes.description: Open-air market beneath the Cairo Citadel, with a crowd gathered in the foreground and the Citadel's mosque and minarets in the background.
hints: He stands mid-ground among the crowd, not at the edges of the photo.
Right of the center, around halfway down the picture.
The young man in robes right of the center: look at his feet, he wears modern athletic sneakers.

scenes.title: Boer War: a busy street scene with gracious ladies offering
scenes.description: Boer War: a busy street scene with gracious ladies offering, Pietermaritzburg, circa 1900, from the Wikimedia Commons catalogue.
hints: Scan the whole photograph; something small is out of place on the ground near a bench or seat, partly hidden.
It is a small modern object in the lower right of the frame.
A Modern daypack is on the ground near a bench or seat, partly hidden, in the lower right.
scenes.explanation: Lightweight nylon daypacks with zips are a later-20th-century product, not yet in use here.

source.originalTitle: Boer War: a busy street scene with gracious ladies offering
source.description: Boer War: a busy street scene with gracious ladies offering food, drink and assistance to wounded soldiers. Process print after C. Shepperson after A. Johnstone, c. 1900. Iconographic Collections Keywords: Agnes M. Johnstone; Claude Alin Shepperson

scenes.title: Market Street and Sussex Street, Sydney (4349494121)
scenes.description: Market Street and Sussex Street, Sydney (4349494121), circa 1900, from the Wikimedia Commons catalogue.
hints: Look closely; something in this photograph is not from this world or this century.
Check the in the middle of the crowd, half behind other people: there is technology that did not exist yet.

The clearly futuristic humanoid robot in the middle of the crowd, half behind other people, in the middle center: sleek metallic limbs and an exposed mechanical head, with an otherwise era-appropriate silhouette.
scenes.explanation: This is a robot from a fictional future, so it could not exist when this photograph was taken.
